title: Ratty Helpers!
description: A mod that adds RATS, this mod lets you tame and cach rats to keep as pets.
body:
This mod adds rats to minecraft as pets!
Rats will fight the entitys at hurt you or you attack and can be tamed with cheese!
Rats will spawn in pains or meadow biomes!
You can store tamed rats in a rat pouch, (NOTE this will remove any name tags put on the rat!),
or you can put rats in a box at when mined the rat will pop out!
Rat bombs when thrown will spawn 4 rats and an explotion!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------You can find all the recipes on the gallery tab!
